{
  "dataset_name": "loan_approval_status_classification",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "income_to_loan_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of income to loan amount, providing a continuous measure of financial capacity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 12000.0],
      "feature_family": "financial_capacity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Helps establish a linear decision boundary for approval by providing a smooth, continuous ratio that scales with repayment ability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "person_income / np.maximum(loan_amnt, 500.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "debt_burden_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction between loan percentage of income and interest rate.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "risk_metrics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a smooth severity measure of debt burden suitable for linear margins, allowing the SVM to penalize high-interest, high-burden loans.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "loan_percent_income * loan_int_rate"
    },
    {
      "name": "credit_history_to_age_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Proportion of adult life spent building credit.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "credit_profile",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Offers a normalized continuous feature that scales linearly with financial maturity, reducing the impact of absolute age.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "cb_person_cred_hist_length / np.maximum(person_age - 17.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "normalized_credit_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Min-max scaled credit score based on typical credit score ranges.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "credit_profile",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ensures smooth gradients and consistent weight updates in linear SVM optimization by keeping the feature scale bounded.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(credit_score - 400.0) / 450.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "employment_stability_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of employment experience to adult age.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 35.0],
      "feature_family": "employment_profile",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Acts as a continuous proxy for career stability that projects well into a linear space, helping separate established workers from transient ones.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "person_emp_exp / np.maximum(person_age - 16.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "rent_burden_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction term isolating the loan burden specifically for renters.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "housing_profile",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the linear model to assign a distinct weight to the vulnerable subgroup of renters with high loan-to-income ratios.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "home_rent * loan_percent_income"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_risk_intent_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Logical OR of historically riskier loan intents (medical, debt consolidation).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "loan_intent",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a clean binary projection for the SVM margin, grouping similar risk profiles into a single dimension.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(intent_medical, intent_debtconsolidation)"
    },
    {
      "name": "annual_interest_burden",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Estimated annual interest cost in absolute terms.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 7000.0],
      "feature_family": "financial_capacity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous financial severity metric that scales linearly with risk, capturing the absolute dollar strain on the borrower.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "loan_amnt * (loan_int_rate / 100.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_income_per_year_of_exp",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed ratio of income to years of experience.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "employment_profile",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooths out extreme outliers in income and experience, improving linear separability and preventing large margin violations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(person_income / np.maximum(person_emp_exp, 1.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "default_history_penalty",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted penalty combining prior defaults with lower credit scores.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "risk_metrics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a composite risk feature that directly pushes risky profiles away from the decision margin, enhancing linear separability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "defaults_yes * (850.0 - credit_score) / 450.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "semantic_risk_assessment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "An overall semantic assessment of the applicant's risk profile, considering the interplay between their age, income level, requested loan amount, and the stated intent of the loan.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_evaluation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures non-linear, common-sense risk factors that deterministic formulas might miss, providing a smooth continuous score for the SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "semantic_repayment_capacity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "A semantic evaluation of the borrower's capacity to repay the loan, synthesizing their employment experience, education level, and home ownership status into a single continuous score.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_evaluation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Projects complex socio-economic indicators into a single linear dimension, simplifying the margin optimization for the SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
